conversation_starters.title: Never-before-heard Prince recordings featured on new album
questions: Has the new Prince album from the vault come up around town?
Is Prince's music still a big part of life in Minneapolis?
conversation_starters.description: The vault is open. Recordings no one's ever heard, spanning 40 years of Prince's musical career, are now available on a new album called "Timeless."

you_should_know.title: St. Paul police release bodycam, surveillance footage of shooting at Regions Hospital
you_should_know.summary: Police in St. Paul, the capital city, just east of Minneapolis, released body-worn camera footage of a shooting at Regions Hospital.
you_should_know.description: St. Paul police released body-worn camera footage of shooting at Regions Hospital that happened earlier this month.
